title: Woot Health Privacy Policy
introduction: Woot Health is committed to protecting your privacy and safeguarding your personal and health information.

sections.title: Health Information
content: Health data is only shared with authorized healthcare providers involved in your care.
We do not sell or misuse your health information.

sections.title: Data Sharing
content: Regulatory authorities when required by law.
All third parties are bound by confidentiality obligations.

sections.title: Data Security
sections.content: We use industry-standard security measures including encryption and access controls to protect your data.

sections.title: Your Rights
content: Request data deletion (subject to legal obligations).
Withdraw consent for certain data uses.

sections.title: Data Retention
sections.content: We retain personal and health data only as long as necessary to provide services and comply with legal requirements.

sections.title: Cookies & Tracking
sections.content: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve user experience and platform performance.

sections.title: Children's Privacy
sections.content: We do not knowingly collect data from children without parental or guardian consent.

sections.title: Updates to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Changes will be communicated on our platform.

sections.title: Contact Us
sections.content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact Support@woothealth.com
